title: Kyle Shanahan: I love calling plays for Mike Evans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan: I love calling plays for Mike Evans
sources.description: Mike Evans built his career with the Buccaneers on being the guy quarterbacks looked to on third down and in the red zone, and it didn't take long for him to take on the same role with the 49ers.
